hook.text: Drinking coffee first thing in the morning is making you more tired. Here's why.
queries: person grabbing coffee mug morning kitchen
fresh brewed coffee pour close up steam

tips.text: Your cortisol naturally peaks at 8 AM. Drinking coffee then doesn't add energy. It just builds tolerance. So your body needs more caffeine over time to feel awake.
queries: person looking tired coffee in hand

tips.text: Instead, wait ninety minutes after waking. Your cortisol naturally drops by then. Coffee will hit harder, last longer, and you won't crash by noon.
queries: watch wristwatch hands showing time closeup
person preparing coffee mid morning kitchen

tips.text: Before coffee, drink twelve ounces of water with a pinch of salt. This rehydrates your cells and balances electrolytes. You'll wake up faster than coffee alone.
queries: glass water salt pinch sprinkling closeup
salt being sprinkled into water glass
hands holding clear water glass morning light

cta.text: Try this for one week. You'll never go back to morning coffee. Follow for more energy tips that work.
queries: person feeling energized morning routine smile
